issue.title: Migrate Maestro E2E to EAS Workflows (Android e2e-test + type: maestro)
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Migrate informational Maestro E2E from GitHub Actions emulator-runner to **Expo’s canonical path**: EAS Workflows `type: maestro` + Android-only `e2e-test` build profile ([EAS E2E docs](https://docs.expo.dev/eas/workflows/examples/e2e-tests/), [maestro job](https://docs.expo.dev/eas/workflows/pre-packaged-jobs/#maestro)).

Parent context: #488 / #497 / #510 (GHA path has been dash/`sh -c` then 90m timeout fragile).

## Scope

**In scope**
- `eas.json` Android-only `e2e-test` profile (`withoutCredentials` + `buildType: apk`; **no iOS**)
- `.eas/workflows/maestro-android.yml` — `workflow_dispatch` suite choice (harness / smokes / multi-account); build → `type: maestro`
- Docs: playbook / `.eas/README.md` / `docs/ci.md` — EAS is primary; GHA optional legacy
- Document EAS env secrets for `MAESTRO_*` (preview)

**Out of scope**
- Maestro Cloud (`type: maestro-cloud`)
- iOS
- Making Maestro a required PR merge gate
- Deleting GHA workflow in this PR (mark legacy; remove later if EAS stable)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `e2e-test` profile Android-only in `eas.json`
- [ ] EAS workflow validates (`workflow_validate` / `eas workflow:run` dry)
- [ ] Suite input maps to harness / smoke / multi-account tags or flow paths
- [ ] Docs state EAS as preferred host + how to run + required EAS secrets
- [ ] Android-only forever (no iOS profile/jobs)

## Verification

1. `eas workflow:run .eas/workflows/maestro-android.yml -F suite=harness` (needs EXPO_TOKEN + project access)
2. Confirm build uses `e2e-test` and Maestro job runs on emulator

comments.body: Shipped in https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/518 — Maestro hosted E2E is EAS Workflows only (GHA path removed).
